about: The Flint Hills Discovery Center in Manhattan hosts Breakfast with Santa on Saturdays, December 5 and 12, 2026.

Guests enjoy breakfast and sweet treats, play games, hear holiday stories, decorate gingerbread men and pose for photos with Santa.
